verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents exporting the cap table or transaction history to Excel/CSV or any other open format. The related items do not qualify: data rooms (vestd-docs-21) store and share files that may include cap tables, 'board-ready reporting' (vestd-docs-18) is unspecified, and migration (vestd-docs-35) moves data into Vestd rather than out of it. None of these is a documented export capability.
